notablePrerequisites: Tarrian's Soulcleaver attached to Evolution Witness.
description:
Cast Lion's Eye Diamond by paying {0}.
Activate Lion's Eye Diamond by sacrificing it and discarding your hand, adding three mana of any color.
Tarrian's Soulcleaver triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Lion's Eye Diamond from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
